pages.text: Industrial Foregoing provides mob farming, fluid automation, and early bio-processing at $(t2)Tier 2$(end).

$(bold)Role in the pack:$(/bold) $(t2)T2$(end) provides access to basic IF machines: Mob Crusher, Mob Duplicator, Animal Rancher, Plant Gatherer. These enable automated material farming.$(br2)$(bold)T3 upgrade:$(/bold) Advanced IF features (the more powerful/complex machines) are $(t3)T3$(end) content. Basic mob and plant farms are T2-accessible.

$(bold)Integration:$(/bold) IF's Fluid Crafter and Laser Drill become important for Mekanism prep at T3. Planning ahead for a Laser Drill setup in $(t2)T2$(end) is a good strategy for a $(t3)T3$(end) shortcut.

$(bold)No book needed.$(/bold) Industrial Foregoing is fully documented in JEI. Every machine has tooltips explaining its function. The $(bold)IFWiki$(/bold) at ftb.fandom.com covers advanced setups like the Mob Duplicator and Infinity Drill.
